articles.title: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: The U.S. Supreme Court hasn't yet indicated whether it will take up cases surrounding prediction markets, but there are now several amicus briefs, an interim final rule and a rule proposal.

articles.title: Clarity's failure could speed crypto innovation while shielding incumbents
articles.snippet: Executives see openings for tokenization, DeFi and dealmaking, while lawyers warn agency action leaves spot-market oversight and lasting certainty unresolved.

articles.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
articles.snippet: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

articles.title: Robinhood Chain slowdown spreads from fees to trading as transactions fall more than 40%
articles.snippet: Daily activity has dropped from 10.8 million transactions to 6.2 million since mid-September even as Robinhood keeps paying network fees on customer swaps.

articles.title: Visa survey says nearly half of APAC consumers open to using stablecoins by 2031
articles.snippet: Visa’s survey of 14,250 people found interest in stablecoin payments is growing, though only 6% of respondents correctly understood how they work.
